info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of prescriptions filled at a pharmacy. This API provides essential information for patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacy staff to track prescription fulfillment. Consumers can utilize this service to check the progress of their medications, ensuring timely access to necessary treatments. It offers an efficient way to enhance communication and coordination in healthcare delivery.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of prescriptions. It is useful for tracking the progress of prescription fulfillment and ensuring that patients receive their medications in a timely manner.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of prescriptions, which includes necessary parameters to filter and obtain the required information.

200.description: Request completed successfully and current prescription status retrieved.
